title: API key authentication (security path)
prompt: Every endpoint except GET /health must require an API key. Add an authentication layer under src/auth/: read the expected key from config (`auth.apiKey`, overridable by the API_KEY environment variable), compare it in constant time against the `x-api-key` request header, and answer 401 `{ error: { message: "unauthorized" } }` when it is missing or wrong. Wire it in front of the router so handlers stay unaware of it, keep GET /health open, add the config default, and unit test allowed, missing, wrong-key and health cases. Note that this touches a security path, so treat it accordingly.
